title: Champions
description:
You both share a set of beliefs, morals, values or maybe a faith
With:__bon1_wi__ (which PC). Your Cause: __bon1_c__

outcomes.text: When you **End the Session** also ask, *"Did we significantly support our cause?" If "Yes", both of you mark 1 XP

pick: Return the Favor - When you help or save a relevant NPC, they now support your Cause. Once in the campaign per helped/saved NPC you may request their aid; they will appear as soon as possible and help you with any current predicament you're in.
You Cannot Kill an Idea - When you **Face Death** while fighting for your Cause, you may choose to **Go Out in a Blaze of Glory** without dying. Each of you can use this Move once in a campaign.

United We Stand - Each of you, once per session, may Aid the other while pursuing your Cause without paying any cost. When either of you **Sense Motive**, you can always ask "Do you believe in my cause?" no matter the result.

title: Comrades in Arms
description:
You support each other through fights and their aftermaths
With:__bon2_wi__ (which PC)

outcomes.text: When you Aid your bondmate when they **Trade Blows**, you may choose one (or none):
bullets: Suffer 1 dmg **piercing** instead of another **Aid A PC** cost
Instead of granting **adv** to their roll, you may add your dmg to theirs. This dmg is still affected by min and max choices

pick: Let It All Out - When you **Comfort or Support** your bondmate by dueling, brawling, or fighting them, they either choose an extra option or mark 1 XP (their choice).
Killer Combo - When you **Trade Blows** with your bondmate's Aid, on a 12+ make an additional choice from the 10+ list.

Training Exercise - When you **Make Camp**, you and your bondmate can choose the same Condition together. Until you next **Make Camp**, you both ignore penalties from that Condition. Condition: __bon2_c__

title: Enthusiasts
description:
You share a passion for a topic, hobby, craft, or similar
Shared Interest: __bon3_si:e.g. cooking, secret history, magic, arena fights, political rumors, birds__

outcomes.text: Once per session, when you discover something new related to your Interest, clear a Condition. If your bondmate is present for the discovery, or when you tell/show them later, choose one from **Comfort or Support**.

pick: Paired Project - When you **Enjoy Downtime**, you may begin working together on a project related to your Shared Interest. Say what it is, and the GM will give you 1-4 requirements (similar to **Perform a Ritual**). When you meet the requirements, you finish the project and each mark 1 Depth with each other (in addition to the project's effects). When you **Enjoy Downtime** with a paired project already underway, together you may ask the GM any one question about it.
Specialists - When you **Defy Danger** in direct relation to your Shared Interest, ignore penalties from Conditions.

Great Minds - When you **Spout Lore** about your Interest, if your fellow enthusiast could answer yes to a question, then you can too, even if they aren't nearby. On a 12+ they may answer instead of the GM.

title: True Lovers
description:
You both share a rare and powerful reciprocated love
With:__bon4_wi__ (which PC)

outcomes.text: Once per session each of you can ask the other, *"Are you thinking about me right now?"* If "Yes", then the responder can **Aid** the asker as if they were in close proximity, with no cost.

pick: Handfasting - When you **both commit to a lifelong partnership**, each of you can now use Always on My Mind a number of times per session equal to your current Depth with your lover (instead of once, min 1).
Let Me Tell You All About Them - When you **wax poetically about your lover to an NPC**, you can **Pull Strings**+your Depth with your lover (instead of +CHA).

Together Forever - When **either of you dies**, the GM will tell the other how to bring you back to life. At the end of the next session (not this one), if you haven't revived your lover, you follow them in death.
